# netskope_network_profile (Resource)

NetworkProfile Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_network_profile" "my_networkprofile" {
  description = "...my_description..."
  name        = "...my_name..."
  values = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name (max 100 characters)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Profile description (max 200 characters)
- `values` (List of String) List of IP addresses, CIDR blocks, or IP ranges

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Network profile ID (UUID)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_network_profile.my_netskope_network_profile
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_network_profile.my_netskope_network_profile "..."
```
